description: Use this when a signed-in user wants their character animated: from a ready AI character design (design_id, recommended when they designed one) or from a character image they shared. Pass exactly one of design_id or image, and the animations they picked (launch, happy, wave, loading; idle is always included for free). Uses 1 credit per picked animation from the user's balance; an animation the engine can't make gives its credit back automatically. The image is checked first: it must be one finished, coloured character (not a sketch, a photo or a group). The character (Rive file with a state machine, code, README, posters) is usually ready a few minutes later; check it with get_character_set. More animations can be added later with add_animations. Videos are exported afterwards with export_videos. Sending the same image (or design) and name again within 10 minutes returns the existing character instead of charging again. An account without a plan gets one free try: exactly one animation, wave or loading (idle comes with it); its MP4 is made automatically and shown in the chat. Requires a linked Charmotion account.

animations.description: The animations to make: launch (app intro, ends on idle), happy, wave, loading. idle is always added for free. Default: all of them.

design_id.description: A ready AI character design of this account (from design_character, get_design or list_designs), instead of an image.

image.description: The character image (PNG, JPEG or WebP, at least 512 px, up to 10 MB). Outside ChatGPT, set download_url to a public https link to the image and file_id to its file name. Leave out when using design_id.

name.description: Short name for the character, e.g. 'Kiko'. Used for file names.

name: create_character_set

ai_readme.description: AI_README.md for a ready set (get_character_set only): which file to use per platform, the mood numbers and trigger names, code samples and checks. Give it to the coding assistant that adds the set to the user's app.

animations.description: The character's animations after this build (null for a 17-animation set made before animations could be picked).

can_add_animations.description: True when add_animations can add more animations to this character now.

expressions.description: Expression step before the build (null when the set was made without it). generating = being made; review = waiting for the user's choice: show them with get_expressions, then call approve_expressions (or they can choose on the set page); approved / skipped = the set builds (skipped = from the drawing only).

failed_animations.description: Animations the engine couldn't make in this build (their credits were given back).

free_try.description: True when this character is the account's free try (one animation).

poster_url.description: A still image of the character (inline link, valid 10 minutes) once it is ready.

video_url.description: An MP4 of the character to show in the chat (inline link, valid 10 minutes), once a video exists.

videos.description: On-demand video exports of a ready set.

title: Animate a character
